args:
/opt/venv/bin/locust --headless -f /app/trainticket_paper.py --run-time "10800s" --exit-code-on-error 0 --csv /tmp/headlight-calibration
rc="$?"
echo __HEADLIGHT_REQUEST_CSV_BEGIN__
cat /app/headlight_requests.csv 2>/dev/null || true
echo __HEADLIGHT_REQUEST_CSV_END__
echo __HEADLIGHT_LOCUST_STATS_BEGIN__
cat /tmp/headlight-calibration_stats.csv 2>/dev/null || true
echo __HEADLIGHT_LOCUST_STATS_END__
exit "$rc"
containers.name: locust

/opt/venv/bin/locust --headless -f /app/trainticket_paper.py --spawn-rate "2" --run-time "60s" --exit-code-on-error 0 --csv /app/headlight-locust

echo __HEADLIGHT_LOCUST_STATS_BEGIN__
cat /app/headlight-locust_stats.csv 2>/dev/null || true
